title: Chapter 299
text:
In space far away from the Blue Star, wormholes of various sizes opened and closed, emitting streams of light that dyed the dark space of the universe in a riot of colors. These lights gathered and scattered like pieces of glowing gauze, bringing with them a hazy and dreamy feeling. The colors were rich, like a gradual spectrum.

In the center of the wormholes, a large space station was floating. Its specific shape was like three skyscrapers stacked together horizontally. There were all kinds of towers extending from the sides and the top. Some were signal towers, some were space stabilizers, and some were weapon and escort hangars.

At the bottom of the space station was a huge white metal sphere. A dark blue ring surrounded the sphere from afar, like the ring of a planet. This was the reactor and power source of the space station, as well as providing gravity to the space station.

The structure of the space station was complex and precise, filled with the beauty of technology. The windows of the 'buildings' were spaceports for spaceships to dock. Without a frame of reference, it was difficult to have a clear understanding of the size of the space station. A spaceport could dock spaceships that were hundreds of meters long, and this space station had tens of thousands of spaceports, like a man-made mountain range.

Juberly Hub, the transportation hub of the Garton Star System.

The surrounding wormholes were built by the various Star System civilizations of the Colton Star Cluster. They used large amounts of resources in exchange for the help of more advanced civilizations to build stable stargates. They could quickly connect to the various Star Systems of the Colton Star Cluster and the Star Zones under them, greatly reducing the time spent on interstellar flight.

The space station was constantly taking in and sending out a large number of spaceships, like a hive surrounded by bees. A small yellow and white spaceship entered one of the spaceports, entering the gravity zone from the zero-gravity space. The body of the spaceship shook slightly, and the bottom of the spaceship entered the orbit of the spaceport. It moved along the orbit for three minutes before entering the hangar.

The interior of the hangar was blue and white. The materials were a combination of special alloys and macromolecules. After a few seconds, a synthetic female voice sounded in the hangar.

"Identity authorization confirmed. Permission granted to dock. Welcome, Godora 741 Galactic Investigation Team, Captain Kerlodd."

Chi!

The hatch opened, and the bridge extended out. A humanoid creature walked out.

This was a male Godora. His skin was pale gold, and his long white hair was combed into seven braids at the back of his head. There was a golden ball-shaped accessory tied to the ends of the braids. His appearance was similar to that of a human, except that the distance between his facial features was slightly wider. His body structure was similar to that of a normal human. He had one head, two hands, two legs, and one root. He did not have any extra limbs such as a tail. He was two meters tall, which was considered average by Godora standards.

Kerlodd belonged to the Godora Interstellar Investigation Bureau. He was the captain of the investigation team. Although he was a captain, he did not have any subordinates. He only had the standard equipment of a Godora investigator and a small spaceship that belonged to the government. The spaceship was about 30 meters long, and it was a single-person spaceship.

Kerlodd was the investigator who was sent to the Blue Star to investigate the Inhumans.

"Wow, a pure-blood Godora. Such a proud race. It's rare to see such a rare sight."

At the entrance of the hangar, a registrar wearing a space station uniform laughed. His appearance was similar to Kerlodd's, but he was much shorter, and his skin was not as golden. He was a half-blood Godora mixed with another race.

"Humph, a subspecies." Kerlodd glanced at the registrar with disdain. Godora valued the purity of their bloodline. This was the tradition of their race. They despised all mixed-bloods and called them "subspecies". The meaning was similar to "bastards", and it was an insult.

The registrar did not care. "Hurry up and register. How long will you stay? Where are you going?"

Kerlodd said, "Two days to refuel. Then we will head to Star Zone 9 to investigate a strange phenomenon in a low-level civilization."

"Star Zone 9? That's a barren and dangerous place. Looks like you've taken on a tough job. "The registrar was very knowledgeable.

"It's just a low-level civilization making a fuss about nothing. They think it's an unexplainable phenomenon because their technology is outdated and they haven't seen the world. They can go back after a simple investigation. It won't take long."

Kerlodd raised his head and walked out of the hangar with pride. He headed to the resting area in the atrium of the space station.

After the two left, the hangar door closed.

After an unknown amount of time, a black, viscous liquid crawled out from the tracks of the spaceport. It wriggled as if it had a life of its own. The area of the viscous liquid was only about one square meter.

The sticky liquid slowly crawled onto the spaceship of The Observer, seeped into the gaps of the spaceship's armor, and disappeared.

…

Blue Star, in a snowy mountain range in the Northern Continent, a black helicopter with the Dark Net logo was parked on top of a mountain.

Han Xiao crossed his arms and looked at the mountain range covered in clouds. The cold air kept drilling into his sleeves and collar. Han Xiao's body was very strong, so he did not feel anything.

However, the pilot wrapped in three layers of cotton clothes was shivering. He asked with a trembling voice, "Hehe … Your Excellency, what are we doing here?"

Han Xiao looked at him in surprise. "You're new here? Haven't you learned the rule of 'don't ask questions'? "

"Y-Yes …" The pilot was so cold that his teeth were chattering. "But we've been here for four days. Compared to the rule, I think it's more important to make sure that I'm mentally prepared to freeze to death here."

Han Xiao was amused. "What's your name?"

"Huang Jian. I just finished pilot training last month …"

Han Xiao was amazed. "Huang Jian, Huang Jian. Huang Jian and Huang Jian. This name sounds very promising. You'll definitely become someone big in the future!"

What else could he do? Huang Jian felt bitter. He could only pretend that he did not hear it and asked, "Your Excellency, how long do we have to stay here?"

"One day at the shortest, half a month at the longest."

Huang Jian's face twitched. Wasn't this a little too long?!

After thinking about it, Huang Jian gathered his courage and asked a question that violated the rule. "What are you waiting for?"

Han Xiao glanced at him. "You'll know when it comes."

There were only two people on the plane. While they were waiting, they could chat with Huang Jian to relieve their boredom. However, most of the time, Han Xiao was watching the matches on the forums. The International All-Star Competition had started, and the champions of each country were competing. The players were extremely lively, and Han Xiao watched it as a way to pass the time.

The players from the other regions were all famous teams from their respective countries, such as Devil from America, Rose Knight from England, Kimchi from Korea, Tulip from France, and so on. Their positions in their respective countries were similar to Temple of God's position in China.

Seeing these familiar teams from his previous life, Han Xiao finally remembered that the champions of the first season were Tulip from France. They were a very powerful club.

The All-Star Competition was a chance to show off. Players from each region would pay attention to it, and it was more than ten times more popular than a single region. The champions of each country would compete with each other and show off their strength. They would praise their opponents before and after the competition. The atmosphere was harmonious. This was a chance for the champions of the regular season to show off their strength.

Temple of God from the Blue Star region had attracted a wave of foreign fans. Their performance was not bad, and Li Ge was able to handle it with ease.

After the All-Star Competition, there was a three-day break before the finals of each region. This time, it was a one versus one, and it was a best of five elimination system. Long Sky was quite lucky and met a slightly weaker foreign club. The powerhouses did not meet each other.

In the individual competition, Hao Tian was not as lucky. They met Li Ge in the first round of the round of 16.

Before the competition, Li Ge did not behave like himself and made a statement.
